sections.name: Financing for acquisitions, ownership transitions and growth.

items.text: Financing for acquisitions, ownership transitions and growth.

A financing conversation starts with understanding the business. Capital Connections brings Capital Row’s transaction intelligence to that conversation, helping buyers and owners clarify their capital needs, identify financial preparation gaps and explore relevant financing introductions.
Our focus is vertical software and software-enabled services businesses.
Acquire a business or transition ownership
Explore financing for a business acquisition, partner buyout or qualifying ownership transition.

We help clarify the transaction, the proposed use of funds and the information a financing provider will need to assess the opportunity. Depending on eligibility and structure, potential routes may include SBA-backed or conventional financing.
Explore capital for expansion, hiring, operating needs or eligible debt refinancing.
The starting point is a clear view of cash flow, existing obligations and how additional capital would support the business.
For businesses with eligible receivables, inventory or other assets, financing may help bridge the gap between delivering services and collecting payment.
Specialist financing may also be worth exploring when a business’s needs fall outside standard bank criteria.
